lines.en: The two of us decide to spend the night together...not really doing anything.
lines.zh: 我们俩决定一起过一晚……也没真的做什么。

lines.en: But it's a pleasant form of nothingness.
lines.zh: 但这种「什么都没做」是舒服的那种。

lines.en: Sara lays down next to me on the bed and moves closer.
lines.zh: Sara 在我旁边的床上躺下，靠了过来。

lines.en: Her eyes lock onto mine and only stray from them in short bursts.
lines.zh: 她的目光锁在我身上，只是偶尔短暂地飘开。

lines.en: But, for the most part, I'm all that she focuses on.
lines.zh: 但大部分时间，她全部的注意力都在我身上。

lines.en: It feels a little uncomfortable at first given that neither of us are saying much.
lines.zh: 一开始有点不自在，因为我们俩都没怎么说话。

lines.en: But once that initial unease subsides, it becomes overwhelmingly apparent to me that this might just be the most comfortable I've felt in a very long time...
lines.zh: 但等最初那份不安退去，我就无比清楚地意识到——这大概是我很久以来最舒服的一刻……

lines.en: Sara falls asleep next to me and I can't find it in myself to wake her up until Ami gets home.
lines.zh: Sara 在我旁边睡着了，我实在不忍心叫醒她，直到 Ami 回家。

lines.en: It's a little awkward having to explain to her that Sara was literally {i}just{/i} sleeping and that nothing else happened at all, but she manages to buy it somehow.
lines.zh: 要跟她解释 Sara 真的{i}只是{/i}在睡觉、别的什么都没发生，有点尴尬，不过她不知怎么就信了。

lines.en: Maybe it's due to how much she likes her or just...the fact that Sara could barely even keep her eyes open on the way out of the house but-
lines.zh: 也许是因为她太喜欢 Sara，或者只是……Sara 出门时眼睛都快睁不开的样子——

lines.en: Well, somehow or another, everything seemed to work out in the end.
lines.zh: 总之，最后一切好像都还顺利。
